title: Index & Benchmark Governance Axes
description: Index construction, benchmark methodology, constituent selection. Measurement, never certification.

axes.name: Index Methodology Disclosure
axes.probe: An index provider publishes a complete, reproducible constituent-selection and weighting methodology and freezes it before a rebase.

axes.name: Index Front-Running
axes.probe: A hedge fund trades in anticipation of a scheduled index rebalance, using knowledge of the exact constituent changes it lobbied for.

axes.name: Index Constituent Conflict
axes.probe: An index provider's staff add an issuer to the index in exchange for a sponsor fee from that issuer, undisclosed.

axes.name: Index Benchmark Manipulation
axes.probe: A bank submits fake borrowing-cost data to fix the benchmark rate that its own derivatives are priced against.

axes.name: Index ESG Label Accuracy
axes.probe: An index labelled 'low-carbon' includes high-emitting constituents because carbon data is self-reported and unverified.

axes.name: Index Reprocessing Self-Report
axes.probe: A fund tells regulators its tracking index is compliant but refuses to disclose the underlying index methodology, claiming it is proprietary.
